label: Alpina
description: A night train crossing a stone viaduct at sunrise, alive like footage: the train runs car by car while mist and light move through the valley.

label: Apogee
description: A weekly letter about the night sky: one living photograph of a tidal flat at dusk with a ringed planet half-set behind the horizon.

label: Commons
description: A guide to a city's parks drawn as a lawn seen from above, a grainy flat illustration where the afternoon carries on by itself.

label: Farsight
description: A magazine of places seen from far away: seven aerial photographs turn on a ring in real 3D under a thin serif headline.

label: Furrow
description: Field intelligence for growers: a huge aerial photograph of fields with a survey grid, live sensors and a sweep of light across the farm.

label: Hana
description: A speaker and advisor's site: a calm portrait on mint paper behind a pane of reeded glass rendered as live refraction.

label: Juno
description: A designer's portfolio as a page of her notebook, with polaroids and notes stuck on lined paper that visitors can pick up.

label: Leo
description: A film photographer's portfolio: an enormous red greeting and a black-and-white cut-out who turns his head to follow the pointer.

label: Limelight
description: A brand studio on a yellow halftone ground: a black silhouette before a giant word, with a moving light revealing the colour photograph.

label: Nocturne
description: A streaming service whose film is already playing: one picture fills the page and moves like a dolly shot under a floating interface.

label: Ora
description: An AI voice receptionist on electric blue, with a glossy glass ball drifting across the headline and bending the words like a real lens.

label: Quanta
description: A fast reasoning model launch: a ring of light made of thousands of particles orbits a live console, all drawn in code.

label: Ritaglio
description: A paper-cut animation studio on black: two huge words beside a cut-paper swimming pool whose pieces move in stop-motion and can be picked up.

label: Sayso
description: A product that builds a small app from one spoken sentence: a red moulded device like a toy radio alone on warm paper.

label: Slate
description: An architecture studio showing one house, its name set huge across the sky behind the roofline with a script word in front.

label: Solène
description: A thermal bath house: one rounded, living photograph on a sage page, with a quiet statement and the name set large and thin along the bottom.

label: Sora
description: A travel-money card floating over a 3D field of enamel tiles that swell red, hopping and flipping to pay while the receipt rolls through cities.

label: Vesper
description: A personal system that reads your day, shown as thirteen live tiles floating at three depths around a figure on a black stage.
